name: axewoo's Switch ports
description: FTL, Shattered Pixel Dungeon, Mindustry and the Tarkov hideout companion, straight from their GitHub releases

packages.name: FTL: Faster Than Light
packages.author: axewoo (FTL-Recompiled by Echo Eclipse)
packages.tagline: Native FTL port. Bring your own ftl.dat
packages.description: A native Switch build of FTL-Recompiled, a C++ reimplementation of FTL: Faster Than Light. The game's data is not included: copy ftl.dat from your own copy of FTL (Steam, GOG...) into sdmc:/switch/ftl/, next to this app. Controls: snap selection by default, tap Minus for a free cursor.
packages.changelog:
## What's Changed
* Add snap selection for the gamepad
* Decode artwork in the background and add a frame-time overlay

packages.name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
packages.author: axewoo (Shattered Pixel Dungeon by Evan Debenham, SwitchGDX)
packages.tagline: The open-source roguelike, v4 on Switch
packages.description: Shattered Pixel Dungeon built for Switch with SwitchGDX. Launch it with title override (hold R on a game) for full memory. Saves go in a data folder next to the app.
packages.changelog:
## What's Changed
* Update to Shattered Pixel Dungeon v4.0.2 + CI-built NRO

## New Contributors
* @axewoo made their first contribution in https://github.com/axewoo/ShatteredPD-NX/pull/1

packages.name: Mindustry
packages.author: axewoo (Mindustry by Anuke, SwitchGDX)
packages.description: Mindustry built for Switch with SwitchGDX. A proof of concept: the first launch builds its shader cache and can take around 15 minutes; later launches take about 20 seconds. Launch it with title override (hold R on a game).
packages.changelog:
## What's Changed
* Switch port on Mindustry v160
* README: describe the Switch port as a proof of concept

## New Contributors
* @axewoo made their first contribution in https://github.com/axewoo/Mindustry-NX/pull/1

packages.name: Tarkov Hideout
packages.author: axewoo
packages.tagline: Offline Escape From Tarkov companion, everything bundled
packages.description: Hideout stations and crafts, needed items, timers, maps, ammo, quests, keys and a gun builder, all offline. This full build bundles every map piece and wiki picture. Progress is saved in sdmc:/switch/TarkovHideout/.
packages.changelog:
## What's Changed
* Gun builder tab like the game's modding screen (v2.11.0)
* README: Settings screenshot with trader levels

packages.name: Tarkov Hideout Lite
packages.author: axewoo
packages.description: The same Escape From Tarkov companion without the bundled maps and pictures: it downloads them when needed. Shares its progress with the full build in sdmc:/switch/TarkovHideout/.
packages.changelog:
## What's Changed
* Gun builder tab like the game's modding screen (v2.11.0)
* README: Settings screenshot with trader levels
